admission.boundary: the seam parses any well-formed triple (1..=128 of [a-z0-9._-]); the boundary carries no target list and no default target
admission.support: a target is supported exactly when the committed pin table carries an entry for it (R10); an absent entry refuses target-unsupported; support is pin content, not a hardcoded list

revocation_fixture.role: second pin entry in every TM01 scene; the native entry is revoked while this one stands, proving support is per-entry pin content
